title: Allow for empty Title text in system monitor applet
line: A System Monitor widget whose title was cleared no longer shows a "System Monitor" tooltip when hovered.
explanation: The widget's tooltip text is its Plasmoid.title, which falls back to "System Monitor" when the face's title is empty, and the sensor value line was always added below it. So clearing the title in the widget settings only replaced it with the generic text. An unset title reads as "System Monitor Sensor" (or the preset's name), so an empty one always means the user cleared it on purpose. The applet now sets an empty tooltip main and sub text in that case, so no tooltip appears; the fallback title is kept for the settings window and other places.

commits.message:
applets/systemmonitor: show no tooltip when the title is empty

When the title of a System Monitor widget was cleared, its tooltip fell
back to a generic "System Monitor" text. An empty title can only come
from the user clearing it, so now the widget shows no tooltip at all.

BUG: 430562

patches.diff:
From 8ca5c281df340b7df026cd0993985fca94721447 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 18:21:11 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/systemmonitor: show no tooltip when the title is
 empty

When the title of a System Monitor widget was cleared, its tooltip fell
back to a generic "System Monitor" text. An empty title can only come
from the user clearing it, so now the widget shows no tooltip at all.

BUG: 430562
---
 .../systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/main.qml | 5 ++++-
 1 file changed, 4 insertions(+), 1 deletion(-)

diff --git a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/main.qml b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/main.qml
index 357c9b18fa..575fc728be 100644
--- a/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/main.qml
+++ b/applets/systemmonitor/systemmonitor/package/contents/ui/main.qml
@@ -59,8 +59,11 @@ PlasmoidItem {
 
     preferredRepresentation: Plasmoid.formFactor === PlasmaCore.Types.Planar ? fullRepresentation : null
 
+    readonly property bool titleCleared: Plasmoid.faceController?.title === ""
+
     Plasmoid.title: Plasmoid.faceController?.title || i18n("System Monitor")
-    toolTipSubText: totalSensor.sensorId ? i18nc("Sensor name: value", "%1: %2", totalSensor.name, totalSensor.formattedValue) : ""
+    toolTipMainText: titleCleared ? "" : Plasmoid.title
+    toolTipSubText: !titleCleared && totalSensor.sensorId ? i18nc("Sensor name: value", "%1: %2", totalSensor.name, totalSensor.formattedValue) : ""
 
     compactRepresentation: CompactRepresentation {
     }
--

review.text: Cleanly suppresses the tooltip in systemmonitor's main.qml when the user explicitly clears the title (Plasmoid.faceController?.title === "") by clearing both toolTipMainText and toolTipSubText, while keeping the "System Monitor" fallback on Plasmoid.title so settings windows and metadata stay labeled. Verified on panel presets with both cleared and non-empty titles.
